business.body:
- Business structure slide splits the company into "OPERATING BUSINESSES" and "INVESTMENTS", describing Recruitment as "India's largest online job classifieds ecosystem" and Real Estate as "A leading platform in online real estate classifieds"; Matchmaking is "Connecting millions for meaningful relationships" and Education "Guiding students toward smarter education & career" (slide text truncated mid-sentence).
- The Company is "primarily engaged in the business of internet based service delivery operating in four service verticals through various web portals": recruitment solutions (primarily naukri.com plus other recruitment portals and ancillary services), 99acres.com, Jeevansathi.com and Shiksha.com.
- Only "Recruitment Solutions" and "99acres" are reportable segments; "the 'Other segments' comprises primarily Jeevansathi & Shiksha verticals are not considered as reportable operating segment since they individually do not meet qualifying criteria for the reportable segment as per Ind AS 108".
- MD & CEO Hitesh Oberoi states "99acres continued to strengthen its market leadership and moved closer to breakeven, while Jeevansathi remained profitable during the quarter."
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Group merger] Scheme of Amalgamation approved Aug 09, 2024 to merge wholly owned subsidiaries Axilly Labs, Diphda Internet Services, Zwayam Digital and (added Feb 05, 2025) Allcheckdeals India into Info Edge; NCLT's April 07, 2026 order was appealed, NCLAT subsequently passed a favourable order dispensing with the Transferee Company's meetings, and the second motion petition has been filed before NCLT New Delhi for sanction of the Scheme.
- [JV exit - Shopkirana] Entire shareholding in Shopkirana E-Trading, held via Startup Investments (Holding) Limited (SIHL), was transferred to Trustroot Internet Private Limited (brand 'Udaan') during the quarter; consideration was 104,868 preference shares of TIPL "aggregating to 2.021% on fully converted and diluted basis at a value of USD 314.40 per share (aggregating to about USD 32.97 Million)", with SIHL separately investing USD 1.72 million for 5,484 preference shares. Shopkirana ceased to be a joint venture.
- [JV swap - Gramophone/Unnati] Entire shareholding in Agstack Technologies ('Gramophone') was transferred to Akshamaala Solutions ('Unnati') for 49,145 preference shares (15.75% of Unnati fully diluted), plus Rs 350.00 million primary infusion for 18,756 preference shares, "thereby taking the aggregate shareholding of SIHL in Unnati to 20.25%"; Gramophone ceased to be a JV and Unnati became a JV.
- [Portfolio IPO] SIHL's board on November 6, 2025 approved "a proposed partial divestment in NoPaperForms Solutions Limited... as a part of its proposed Initial Public Offering (IPO) process including pre-IPO secondary transaction(s)", subject to regulatory clearances.
- [Listed investments] Gains/losses on Eternal Limited (formerly Zomato Limited) and PB Fintech Limited are fair-valued through OCI; following NCLT approval dated August 29, 2025, JV Makesense Technologies merged into PB Fintech and the PB Fintech shares received were reclassified as a financial investment fair valued at each reporting date under Ind AS 109.
- [Regulation] "On November 21, 2025, the Government of India notified the four 'Labour Codes'... consolidating 29 existing labour laws", introducing a uniform definition of wages and enhanced leave and gratuity provisions; the remeasurement impact has been disclosed under exceptional items.

deepdive.thesis: Info Edge delivered strong standalone recruitment growth (14% revenue, 58% margin) and cash flow (Rs.619cr Q4), driven by AI-powered monetization and market share gains, while 99acres posted a one-time Rs.20cr revenue boost from warranty reversal but showed sustainable traffic leadership (52% share) and path to cash positivity in FY27; JobHai and AI-Rex represent scalable new revenue streams.

open.item: Shiksha's stated priority for the coming year is to complete the pivot from information provision to a comprehensive counselling and marketing services proposition, including stronger domestic counselling, better enquiry-to-application conversion and AI-driven voice bots.
Management expects the combined matchmaking portfolio (Jeevansathi plus Aisle) to break even in FY27 and to sustain healthy, profitable growth from there.
99Shorts, the Instagram-style short-video feed for real-estate project discovery recently launched in NCR, is planned for expansion to other major cities in the coming year.
99Shorts, launched in NCR as an Instagram-style short-video feed for real-estate project discovery, is planned for expansion to other major cities in the coming year.

Shiksha will continue to diversify the study-abroad business towards emerging destinations (Germany, Japan, South Korea, the UAE and Ireland are named as where student choice is shifting) that better align with changing student preferences.

Management explicitly flags that the single most important development for Shiksha during FY26 was a visible decline in organic traffic, as AI chatbots and AI-generated search summaries let users get answers without visiting content platforms - a risk it calls particularly acute for guidance platforms that monetise attention rather than transactions.
99acres has a near-term goal of 60% web traffic time share (from 51% in March 2026, up from 32% in June 2024).

Management expects revenue in the education business (Shiksha) to decline in the near term, owing to AI-compressed organic traffic and a study-abroad segment hit by immigration negativity and tightening visa policies.

Job Hai, already the market leader in Delhi NCR, is building the playbook for expansion into Mumbai, Bengaluru and other key metros, with the immediate priority being to strengthen leadership where traction is established before gradually widening to additional metropolitan and large urban centres.
Management expects Job Hai to be a significant contributor to group revenue in the medium to long term.

The matchmaking portfolio is to sustain high revenue growth while maintaining a disciplined investment approach that keeps the portfolio at or near breakeven and contributes to long-term cash flow generation (Directors' Report).

open.horizon: closing pending as at the date of the Directors' Report (May 22, 2026)

Ltd. in consideration for preference shares of TIPL aggregating 2.021%; as at the date of the report the closing remains subject to conditions precedent and clearance from the authorised dealer bank, after which Shopkirana will cease to be an associate.

The Company will continue to support innovation through its investments in technology-led businesses and alternative investment funds, while maintaining a disciplined approach towards capital allocation and risk management.
Job Hai is building the playbook for expansion from Delhi NCR into Mumbai, Bengaluru and other key metros.

risks.note: The Company states it relies heavily on the recruitment business in India for its profits and cash flows. Mitigation cited is that recruitment revenues are spread across several industry segments and that Info Edge has been consciously diversifying into other businesses to de-risk the dependency - the AR quantifies the progress as 'The Company's other businesses now contribute 26.1% of the total standalone revenue', i.e. recruitment still accounts for roughly three-quarters. A second concentration is geographic: the BRSR states overseas revenue is only 6.43% of total revenue, so the portfolio is almost entirely exposed to the Indian cycle.

Two-sided technology risk stated explicitly. Externally, AI chatbots and AI-generated search summaries let users get answers without visiting content platforms - management calls the resulting decline in organic traffic the single most important development for Shiksha in FY26 and says the challenge is particularly acute for guidance platforms that monetise attention rather than transactions. Internally, the AR states that if Info Edge is unable to transform existing services by leveraging AI, or if its AI and big data capabilities fail to yield satisfactory results, its platforms may not effectively match users, recommend services or scale new AI-first offerings, potentially affecting win rates, market share, revenue and profits; more broadly innovation could render existing propositions redundant.
risks.risk: AI disintermediation of search-led discovery, and failure to transform existing services with AI

risks.note: The Company stores and processes large volumes of personal and behavioural data and faces technical failures, server breakdowns, data corruption, security breaches and improper use or disclosure of personal information; any such event could deter users, damage reputation, create legal liability, invite regulatory scrutiny and materially affect the business. The BRSR names Cybersecurity and Data Privacy as material issue #1 and specifies regulatory penalties under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 as a negative financial implication. Mitigations stated: a secondary disaster recovery site in India, continuous AI/ML-driven security monitoring, data encryption, network protection, internal and third-party assessment, industry-standards compliance and proactive management of technology obsolescence.

The AR states the Company carries a large exposure to investee startups spanning listed, non-listed and strategic investments, that these may not generate returns and could absorb additional cash during incubation or early stages, and that a substantial part of investments made over the years has already been written off, exited or provisioned for - described as calculated risks forming part of the growth strategy. Critically, it also warns that reported equity holdings in investee companies may not translate into an equivalent economic interest, due to the terms of investment (including senior rights granted to certain investors) or ESOP-related dilution. Exposure and write-off amounts are financial-statement data and are deliberately not extracted here.
risks.risk: Investment portfolio risk (startup and AIF exposure)

risks.note: All of the Company's platforms face direct competition in both online and offline spaces. Managed through continuous competitive tracking, product innovation, brand investment and customer engagement. This sits alongside 'Brand Value' risk - the platforms are built on well-known brands, and any negative implication for those brands, amplified by the reach of social media, is called a significant risk.

Most of the portfolio depends on network effects - platform value rises with user count - so declining participation, quality erosion or platform disintermediation is a direct business risk. Separately, users may engage in intentional or negligent misconduct including fraudulent postings, spam or inappropriate content, which may damage brand image or expose the Company to claims such as defamation or invasion of privacy; continuous web-traffic monitoring, content filters and profile verification are the stated controls.
risks.risk: Network effects, platform integrity and user-generated content liability

risks.note: The Company operates where government continues to consider regulation of various facets of online businesses, with many such regulations at different levels of deliberation that could significantly impact product offerings and services. Changes in privacy laws may impact its ability to collect, process or share personal data; it typically seeks users' prior consent before sharing, but the evolving legal landscape requires continuing attention (the sentence is truncated in the source).

Revenues from certain segments are sensitive to the economic cycle, with trade wars, tariff barriers, geopolitical conflict, persistent inflation and tighter financial conditions named; business diversification and a healthy balance sheet are the stated mitigants. Related treasury risk: the Company holds significant cash and cash equivalents to preserve financial flexibility, and channels part of it into treasury investments to earn returns, exposing it to market conditions and interest-rate movements - managed through prudent balance-sheet management and a defined investment framework. A third channel is capital availability: given the current phase of the expansion strategy, the Company may need additional capital and could face challenges obtaining it in a timely manner or on acceptable terms.
